title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1257: Bloodline transfer (2)

section.p: Sea of Stars.
Xia Longwu was still waiting.
Finally, a myriad race Invincible said, “He’s dragging this out! Xia Longwu, what’s the point? Do you think more people will affirm their dao?”
Someone else said “Send more people over. Kill anyone attempting to affirm their dao. Xia Longwu, you might yet survive if you give up now. Otherwise, we will start attacking.”
They were unwilling to give him more time.

Xia Longwu looked at them, inhaled, and said, “What’s the rush? If you send more people away, will you have the numbers to kill me? Be careful lest you fail to stop my dao affirmation. When I complete my dao affirmation, I will kill all of you.”
He appeared perfectly calm as he made that declaration. Yet his calmness caused everyone to shiver. He was definitely capable of doing something like that.
Finally, a devil Invincible lost patience and urged, “Attack!”
What was the point of waiting?
Were they supposed to attack after he completed his dao affirmation?

In truth, it wasn’t that they didn’t want to attack. Rather, some were fearful of the humanity. What if the human Invincibles decided to fight to the death? They were especially wary of people like Great Xia King.
At that moment, someone else arrived. His crimson hair fluttered in the air as his devilish aura spread out around him.
Numerous expressions changed upon his arrival.
“Blood Fire Devil King!”

The leader of the blood fire devil race. This was the most violent and combative race of the devils. And the person who had arrived was not a regular Invincible from this race. Rather, it was the leader of the race. In fact, he was strong enough to be the Pseudo Emperor of the blood fire devils if they were to become independent from the greater devil race.
He said, “Qin Guang or Xia Wushen. Are either of you interested in a fight?”
Great Xia King replied coldly, “Since you wish to die, I’ll oblige.”
Instantly, the two vanished into an alternate dimension.
Great Xia King had no choice but to do this.

The Blood Fire Devil King was too strong. Apart from Great Xia King, Great Qin King, and Great Zhou King, very few people could deal with him. But since they were all here to protect Great Xia King’s grandson, he had no choice but to step forth when a truly dangerous enemy arrived.

Quite a lot of myriad race Invincibles were relieved to see Great Xia King gone. In fact, he was the one they feared most here. After all, they were here for his grandson. He was the most likely human Invincible to start going crazy.
Next, a divine king and an immortal king arrived.
“Lightning Divine King.”
“Ninth Heaven Immortal King.”
With their arrival, numerous people braced themselves. The battle was finally going to start.
Unsurprisingly, Great Qin King sighed and stepped forth. He said, “Since even the two of you are here, let’s spend some time together.”
The two newcomers did not bother to say anything. This was why they were here.
Great Qin King and Great Xia King.

Spear of Qin and blade of Xia. The two had gained their fame through slaughter. With them around, everyone would be wary. They knew that they could win with their superior numbers, but nobody wanted to be the unlucky individuals to die during the battle. And now, the two had finally been removed.
The myriad race Invincibles exhaled in relief. With the two out of the picture, they started stirring. Before they could attack, yet another Invincible arrived.
“Celestial Wing Divine King.”
The divine king looked at Great Ming King and said, “Come on, Great Ming King. Let’s have a spar.”
“Do you think I’m scared of you?”
The two vanished with a flicker.

Shortly after, three more Invincibles arrived. These were slightly weaker than the few who had arrived before them. One of them said, “Great Zhou King, you should settle with your current gains. Your Zhou Family has gained two new Eternals. Why are you involving yourself in this? Come on. You’ll be fighting us.”

Great Zhou King said nothing. He looked around before stepping forth and vanishing alongside the three Invincibles. Seeing the powerful human Invincibles leaving one after another, the myriad race Invincibles started growing excited.
Those were the human Invincibles whose ability to kill other Invincibles was not in doubt. They were also the greatest deterrent to the myriad race Invincibles from doing anything.
With them gone, the myriad race Invincibles had nothing to fear anymore. One of them said, “Split the battlefield.”

With that, the area was split into segments of alternate dimensions. One human Invincible after another was forced into the alternate dimensions to do battle. They had no choice as fighting directly out there would reduce the probability of Xia Longwu succeeding to zero.
Before long, only a few human Invincibles were left around Xia Longwu. Meanwhile, they were faced with over thirty myriad race Invincibles.
With a sigh, Xia Longwu said, “Seniors, just leave.”
They would die if they remained. There were too many enemies for them to handle.

One of the remaining Invincibles was Heavenly Forge King. He looked around helplessly. This was hopeless. Nevertheless, he was unwilling to leave. He looked at the myriad race Invincibles coldly and said, “Bring it on. Let’s take a tour of the void.”
Then, about seven or eight myriad race Invincibles vanished alongside the remaining human Invincibles.
“Xia Longwu!”
The remaining myriad race Invincibles started laughing.
“Are you going to keep struggling?”

There were still over twenty Invincibles around him. Clearly, they were taking this very seriously. The same Invincible who had spoken laughed and threw a fist. As far as he was concerned, Xia Longwu was already dead.
All of a sudden, the clouds above them churned while space started twisting and warping, alarming numerous people. Next, one ancient city after another appeared.
There were nine of them.
An Invincible questioned in fury, “Are the ancient cities getting involved in this?”
Every one of the thirty-six guardians was an ancient Invincible. With their aid, Xia Longwu would almost be guaranteed to succeed.
At that question, a silhouette appeared above one of the cities and said, “The ancient cities are not involved. But we will be involving ourselves in our personal capacities as Xia Longwu’s friends.”
All nine mayors appeared above the cities.
Clad in his white robes, Mayor Tian He smiled as he looked around. But next, he sighed and said, “Brother Longwu…this is…very challenging.”
There were over twenty Invincibles present.
Was this a joke?

When they agreed on the plan, they had never expected that they would need to face so many enemies. Almost all the human Invincibles had helped as well, keeping a considerable number of enemies occupied. However, there were still too many enemies left.

As ancient city mayors, they were either ninth-stage Sunmoons or Pseudo Invincibles. How were they supposed to handle so many Invincibles? Were they supposed to just throw their lives away? The nine mayors felt exceedingly helpless.
With nine ancient cities forming a circle around Xia Longwu, the myriad race Invincibles grew wary. At that moment, the sky warped as a loud voice rang out.
“Are the guardians…getting involved in this?”
That was the Devil Pseudo Emperor.

Heavendoom replied coldly, “This is a personal affair of the mayors. As long as the cities are left unmolested and no laws are broken, we will not interfere.”After a short silence, the Devil Pseudo Emperor said, “Ignore the cities. If the mayors try to get in our way, kill them.”
Since the stone statues had made their neutrality clear, the Devil Pseudo Emperor had nothing else to say.
Meanwhile, Xia Longwu ignored the conversation as he finally started his dao affirmation in earnest.

In the blink of an eye, the progress of his fusion advanced significantly. Seeing that, the myriad race Invincibles finally lost their patience. They might be wary of the stone statues, but that wariness did not extend to the mayors. For them, these mayors were no different than mere bugs.
The stone statues had promised to stay neutral as long as the cities were unmolested. In that case, they had nothing to fear. The mayors posed no threat to them.
A devil king appeared before Tian He and threw a punch at him.

With a curse, Tian He hurriedly fused with a death spirit. Then, he drew his sword with a roar. The clash sent him flying as the death qi in his body churned violently. He gnashed his teeth and cursed yet again.
They were still too weak to fight Invincibles. Sure, they could keep an Invincible occupied for a short time. But in a prolonged battle, they would die to either the Invincible or their death qi.

With the mayors occupied, about four to five Invincibles charged through the circle formed by the ancient cities and headed straight toward Xia Longwu. Everyone was certain this was the end of Xia Longwu.
But right at that moment, a different ancient city appeared.

From the mayor’s residence, Su Yu walked out. He glanced at Xia Longwu, but he did not join the battle. It wasn’t like he could contend against Invincibles anyway. Instead, he offered, “Prefect Xia, you may seek temporary shelter in the city if you find your opponent too challenging.”
The myriad race Invincibles had thought that Su Yu was here to fight as well. But when they heard his words, they started sneering.
Temporary shelter?

Xia Longwu was in the middle of dao affirmation. Entering an ancient city during the process was the same as crippling himself. At that time, there wouldn’t even be a need for them to kill him anymore. The death qi in the city would be enough to kill him.
Xia Longwu glanced at Su Yu and said nothing.
Temporary shelter?
Would he still be Xia Longwu if he entered the city? Would he still be Xia Longwu if he was converted into a death spirit?

He gave no reply. As long as Su Yu remained in the city, he would be fine. In fact, he saw this as a good thing. He sent Su Yu a voice transmission, “Take a good look at the real Sky Sundering Saber. Watch properly.”
Long ago, he had passed Su Yu a message through Marquis Xia that Su Yu was allowed to observe during his dao affirmation. And now, it was time to fulfill that promise.
His saber qi raged and surged into the sky.
“Sky! Sunder!”
The blade descended, rending the sky apart as it fell upon an Invincible.
The resulting clash was deafening.
The target of the blade was forced to take several steps back. Slowly, a line of blood appeared on his forehead. A look of overwhelming shock appeared in his eyes.
“There are nine stances to the Sky Sundering Saber.”
In a perfectly calm manner, Xia Longwu explained, “Today, I will show you the real Sky Sundering Saber. Witness the prowess of the saber of nine stances with your own eyes.”

As he raised his saber again, his saber qi turned gold. One saber split into countless sabers before combining into one descending saber, dropping down upon a different Invincible. The Invincible in question was a sword user, so he responded with his sword.

It resulted in yet another clash, that was just as deafening as the previous clash. At that moment, a few other Invincibles charged toward Xia Longwu together. They all looked shocked and horrified even as they charged.
Xia Longwu was far stronger than they had imagined. He was ranked fifth on the Dao Affirmation Ranking, yet he was as strong as a real Invincible.
“Third stance.”
With another roar, his saber swirled around him before sweeping out.
“Fourth stance.”
A wave of incomparably dense killing intent surged, to the point even Su Yu felt suffocated from inside his city.
